findings.description: John Nielssen was born in 1846; the 1877 Bygland baptism of his son Torjus gives the father, Jon Nilson, a birth year of 1846 and the mother, Anne Torjusdatter of Klep, 1852. The entry states no birthplace for him.

details.place: not stated (record from Bygland, Aust-Agder, Norway)

supporting_sources: Norway, Church Books, 1797-1958 — baptism entry for Torjus, son of Jon Nilson and Anne Torjusdatter, 17 Oct 1877
